app.name: OptiBienestar 360
app.tagline: We care for what you love most

validation.passwordSameAsCurrent: The new password must differ from the current one

login.heading: Welcome back
login.subheading: Sign in with your credentials to access the portal.

recover.heading: Recover password
recover.subheading: We'll send you a link to reset your password.
recover.sentDescription: If the email exists, you'll receive a link to reset your password.

reset.heading: Reset password
reset.subheading: Set a new password for your account.
reset.successDescription: You can now sign in with your new password.
reset.invalidLinkDescription: The recovery token is missing. Request a new link from “Recover password”.
reset.errorFallback: The link is invalid or has expired

changePassword.heading: Change password
changePassword.hint: The new password must be at least 10 characters, with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a number and a symbol.
changePassword.successDescription: Sign in again with your new password.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Manage system users, their data and roles.
users.noPermissionCreate: You don't have permission to create users
users.noPermissionEdit: You don't have permission to edit
users.noPermissionDelete: You don't have permission to delete
users.modalCreateDescription: Create an account and assign one or more roles.
users.modalEditDescription: Update the user's data and roles.
users.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete {name} ({email})? This deactivates the account.

roles.title: Roles and permissions
roles.subtitle: Create roles and adjust the permissions (keys) each one grants. The SYSTEM role is immutable.
roles.noPermissionCreate: You don't have permission to create roles
roles.modalCreateDescription: The name must be UPPER_SNAKE_CASE (e.g. GERENTE_ALIADO). Then assign permissions.
roles.modalEditDescription: Update the role's name or description.
roles.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete the {name} role? The backend applies smart delete: it fails if the role is in use.
roles.permissionsModalDescription: Check the keys this role grants. It must have at least one permission.
roles.permissionsCatalogError: Could not load the permissions catalog (/v1/admin/permissions).
